effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Main Phase] By placing 1 [Cyborg] or [Aquatic] trait card from your hand face down under this Tamer, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) and gain 1 memory.
[Main] By suspending this Tamer and trashing 2 bottom face-down cards from under any of your Tamers, 1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a [Cyborg] or [Aquatic] trait Digimon card in the hand with the cost reduced by 2.
security_effect_description_eng: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
